papers.abstract: Vision Transformers (ViTs) have gained significant attention, but their high computing cost limits the practical applications. While post-training quantization (PTQ) reduces model size and speeds up inference, it often degrades performance, especially in low-bit settings. We identify two key reasons for the performance degradation: 1) existing quantization methods fail to align with the power-law distribution of post-Softmax activations, and 2) reparameterizing post-LayerNorm activations leads to a performance drop due to the significant influence of outliers in the scaling factors. To address these challenges, we propose DopQ-ViT, a Distribution-friendly and Outlier-aware Post-training Quantization method for ViTs. First, DopQ-ViT introduces the Tan Quantizer (TanQ), which better preserves the power-law distribution of post-Softmax activations by focusing more on values near 1. Second, DopQ-ViT presents the MAD-guided Optimal Scaling Factor (MOSF), which selects the optimal scaling factor without introducing additional calculations. Extensive experiments across various ViT models and quantization settings demonstrate that DopQ-ViT, with the help of TanQ and MOSF, outperforms previous PTQ methods on both classification and detection tasks.

analysis.key_results: 在多种ViT模型和量化设置上，DopQ-ViT在分类和检测任务上均优于以往的后训练量化方法。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出DopQ-ViT，一种分布友好且异常值感知的ViT后训练量化方法，包含Tan量化器和MAD指导的最优缩放因子，以提高低比特量化下的性能。
analysis.method: 通过Tan量化器（TanQ）更好地保留post-Softmax激活的幂律分布，并引入MAD指导的最优缩放因子（MOSF）在不增加额外计算的情况下选择最优缩放因子。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出一种针对ViT的后训练量化方法DopQ-ViT，通过Tan量化器保持Softmax后的幂律分布，并利用MAD指导的最优缩放因子减轻异常值影响，在分类和检测任务上显著优于现有方法。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该论文专注于视觉Transformer的量化，与VLA、WAM或机器人动作-世界建模无直接关系，但作为一种高效推理技术，对资源受限环境下的视觉模型部署具有普适价值。

figures.caption: Overview of DopQ-ViT. (1) DopQ-ViT proposes the distribution-friendly Tan Quantizer to address the imbalance in the distribution of post-Softmax activations, thereby enhancing the practicality of low-bit quantization. (2) DopQ-ViT introduces an outlier-aware method MOSF to address the inter-channel variation in post-LayerNorm activations, aiming to select the MAD-guided optimal scaling factor and mitigate accuracy degradation during the reparameterization process.
